title: Fleet reshuffle and procurement timeline - Q4 2025->Q3 2026
content:
Purpose:
Quick working sheet to capture a proposed staggered procurement cadence and fleet reshuffle plan. Goal is to keep hosted and dedicated SLOs met while we transition to mixed-precision/quantized fleet in 2026, and avoid a single-quarter spike in capital commitments.

Notes / Context:
- Capacity pressure observed in US-WEST and EU-CENTRAL during weekday peak windows (p90 latency breaches for generations when utilization > 78%).
- We want a 15% operational safety buffer for Dedicated pools and a 10% buffer for Hosted spare capacity.
- Priority: ensure EU-CENTRAL Dedicated customers are covered through Q2 2026 while we migrate some traffic to newly provisioned APAC nodes.
- Procurement windows are constrained by vendor lead times and quarterly logistic blackouts (Chinese New Year impact).

Assumptions (high-level):
- Vendor A lead time (RTX-class): 9-12 weeks from PO.
- Vendor B lead time (Ampere XX): 6-9 weeks but limited regional availability for APAC.
- Spot/short-term rentals provide up to 15% of needed capacity but add cost and jitter.
- Planned model quantization reduces per-token compute by ~18% on average for current workloads (applies to ~40% of requests by Q3 2026).

Order plan (working CSV):
quarter,region,sku,units,expected-arrival-window,justification,contingency
Q4-2025,US-WEST,Ampere-48G,24,2026-01-15 to 2026-02-05,replace older 80G nodes,immediate rental top-up if delayed
Q1-2026,EU-CENTRAL,Ampere-80G,12,2026-03-10 to 2026-04-01,cover Dedicated pool growth,cross-ship 4 units from US if customs delay
Q1-2026,APAC-SOUTHEAST,Ampere-48G,16,2026-03-20 to 2026-04-10,new-region launch support,use Vendor B accelerated lane if possible
Q2-2026,US-EAST,Ampere-XX-quant,20,2026-05-25 to 2026-06-15,capacity for increased embedding workloads,defer non-critical training rigs
Q3-2026,EU-CENTRAL,Ampere-XX-quant,10,2026-08-01 to 2026-08-21,complete migration for low-latency model family,temporary regional borrowing ok

Lead time sensitivity table (est):
sku,nominal-lead-days,95pct-lead-days,notes
Ampere-48G,70,95,customs risk in EU during Q1; packing delays reported
Ampere-80G,85,120,heavy demand from cloud providers; plan early PO
Ampere-XX-quant,100,140,requires pre-production validation; expect extra 2-3 weeks for firmware

Utilization triggers and rules (automated alerts):
- Route additional traffic to cheaper model variants when regional sustained 15-min utilization > 72% AND p95 latency > target.
- Create emergency PO if regional committed utilization > 82% for 10 business days.
- Autoscale burst pool if short-term spot cost < 2.4x base per-token cost AND expected burst < 48 hours.

Risk register (short):
- Single-vendor concentration: currently 62% of planned units from Vendor A. Mitigation: split final tranche with Vendor B or include rental contract.
- Customs/port strike in EU: identify 6 units cross-ship contingency from US-WEST.
- Firmware/compatibility with quantized runtime: hold 2 units for validation per region before rolling to production.

Open questions / unresolved:
- Can procurement accelerate Ampere-XX-quant samples? (INFRA-2198)
- Confirm budget split for Q1 vs Q2 orders with finance (quarterly capex cadence).
- Should we pre-book logistic slots for EU shipments to avoid spring congestion?

Action items (owners and rough ETA):
- Aisha: finalize PO split with Vendor A/B by 2025-11-25 (ETA: 2025-11-25).
- Diego: run validation on Ampere-XX-quant sample units in test cluster (INFRA-PR-134) (ETA: 2025-12-10).
- Lina: update routing policy to add 'regional-borrow' flag across Dedicated pools (ETA: 2025-12-01).
- Marcus: coordinate spot rental vendors and get 30-day cost quotes (ETA: 2025-11-26).

Quick cost sketch (approx):
- Ampere-48G unit cost: $14k (landed varies by region).
- Ampere-80G unit cost: $28k.
- Ampere-XX-quant prototype: $22k.
- Expected Q1 total capex (if all Q4 backlog and Q1 orders executed): ~$1.1M (subject to final quotes).

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep one validation bay per region (2 units) offline until firmware validated.
- Talk to procurement about splitting shipments to avoid single customs block.
- If Vendor B offers express lane for APAC, accept even at small premium — launch deadlines are hard.

References / links:
- Jira: INFRA-2198 (procurement pipeline + vendor comms), INFRA-2212 (regional availability), INFRA-2240 (runtime quant validation)
- Confluence draft: confluence:gpu-ordering-playbook-2025 (working)
- Slack threads: #infra-procurement, #sre-incident-2025-11

Stamp: working draft for exec and infra-review. Expect frequent edits; numbers here are operational placeholders and need final quotes and finance approval.
